description:
Lists current code of an imported repository that lacks a protection the project's own
fixes keep adding, learned from the diffs of its past fixes: unguarded access to structures
fixes had to guard, including an entry checked to exist but read at [0] without checking it
has an element, or passed to a function that dereferences it (R1); results of functions that
fixes had to null-check, called the way the fixes checked them and declared nullable, used
unchecked (R7); plain objects used as dictionaries keyed by request input and written through
the looked-up value, obj[k].x = v (R2, prototype pollution; a one-level write is only a
hardening note); template variables inserted unescaped where another
file sanitizes them (R3). Optional `zone` (path prefix or words) and `kind` (R1, R2, R3, R7).
kind="UI" lists the interface instead: translation keys missing from the base locale or
called without the values their text needs (U1), screens that await a request on opening
without handling its failure (U4), and, not validated on history, accessibility notes (U5).
Each site says why it was flagged; `measured_on_history` gives, per kind, how often such
sites turned out to need a fix when the detectors were run on the code of a year earlier.
Candidates are not confirmed bugs.
name: hokmah_risky_code
title: Find Code Missing a Protection
